UBC Campus + Community Planning

Wesbrook Place Lot BCR 7 - DP24018

The application includes five buildings. Along Wesbrook Mall: a 14-storey market rental residential tower with 2-storey townhomes at the base and a 6-storey faculty/staff rental building. Along the east side of the lot, adjacent to the new park: three 6-storey faculty/staff rental buildings with 2-storey townhomes at the base of each. A total of 303 units will be provided with 2.5 levels of underground parking. The total building area: 21,784.1 sq. m (234,481.7 sq. ft.)

Location Wesbrook Place Lot BCR 7 - Mid-block between Gray Ave and Binning Ave Proponents UBC Properties Trust

The UBC Vancouver campus consists of 994 acres (402 hectares) of academic and residential areas on the traditional territory of the Musqueam people.
